meta.title: Balance card patch
meta.description: Adds a "balance ⇄ OpenCode Go quota" mode switch to the balance & cost card: one click in the popover header flips the card from the ¥ wallet to the Go quota as used percentages plus a green progress bar (5-hour / weekly / billing-period rows, with a "used today" total beneath them). The patch ships with this plugin and is re-applied automatically after a reinstall or update.
